description: Election Commission - Declare the new members of the Colombo Municipal Council; Galgamuwa Pradeshiya Sabha and Lahugala Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with filling vacancies in local government councils (Colombo Municipal Council, Galgamuwa Pradeshiya Sabha, and Lahugala Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically addresses electoral processes including declarations of elected members to fill seats vacated due to resignation, death, or party membership cessation. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) as it concerns electoral matters and declarations rather than government personnel appointments or structural changes.
